why: THE PRODUCT'S FIRST NON-NEGOTIABLE RULE, on the one path story 7.0 could break it: infra failures are never reported as product FAIL (CLAUDE.md, AD-6, AD-7, ADR-002). The plan carries a browser probe, the machine cannot provision a browser (the corpus shadows npm), and a declared gate says no. A gate failure makes the pipeline stop early and jump PAST the probes stage to aggregate (src/pipeline/run-pipeline.ts, the product-negative branch), so the browser executor -- the thing that refuses an unusable environment -- never runs. Without a guard the run therefore reports the BRANCH as broken, exit 1 FAIL, while the real reason it adjudicated nothing was that this product could not build the environment it needed. That is an environment problem wearing a verdict's clothes, and it is exactly the inversion that gets a verification gate switched off. THIS FIXTURE WAS WRITTEN BEFORE THE FIX AND SEEN RED AT exit 1 FAIL. The failing gate is real and ordinary; the fixture is not about the gate. It pins that a run which could not adjudicate a criterion its plan says only a browser can adjudicate does not get to conclude anything about the branch: exit 3, infraError infra, no verdict. The gate's own result stays visible in the timeline, so nothing the run did learn is thrown away -- what it may not do is publish a conclusion it did not reach. E7-01 is reported skipped, which is honest: it was never adjudicated, and it sits under an infra outcome rather than under a verdict, so it cannot be read as green for nothing.
